svg.text: The Carnot cycle on a P–V diagram
WHY IT IS THE MOST EFFICIENT CYCLE POSSIBLE
• Every process is reversible: heat is added and rejected isothermally at the two reservoir temperatures.
• No heat crosses a finite temperature difference, so no entropy is generated.
• The enclosed area is the net work W = Q_H − Q_C.
• Its efficiency depends only on the two temperatures: η = 1 − T_C/T_H.
Original teaching schematic • conceptual, not a construction/operating drawing
